title: Negating a sign by flipping its bit
statement: For any finite bit string $s$, assign sign $-1$ when its first bit is $1$ and sign $+1$ otherwise, treating an empty string as having first bit $0$. Replace that first bit by its complement and discard all remaining bits; the sign of the resulting string is the negative of the original sign.
